test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: Implementing a comprehensive digital literacy program in rural schools will significantly enhance local economic opportunities by preparing the youth for the modern job market.

Assumptions: I. Rural students currently lack the digital skills required for the modern job market.

II. Modern job markets prioritize digital literacy.

III. Economic opportunities are directly linked to the job market readiness of the youth.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit
All I, II and III are implicit

solution:
Assumption Analysis

 

I. Rural students currently lack the digital skills required for the modern job market.

Valid — If they already had sufficient digital skills, implementing such a program would not be necessary or impactful.

 

II. Modern job markets prioritize digital literacy.

Valid — The statement directly links digital literacy to preparation for the modern job market, so this must be assumed.

 

III. Economic opportunities are directly linked to the job market readiness of the youth.

Valid — The claim that economic opportunities will improve depends on youth being employable and job-ready

 

All I, II and III are implicit

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
